name: Scott
verdict: Swiss bike brand of Scott Sports SA, controlled by South Korean manufacturer Youngone Corporation (~97% after a 2025 ICC arbitration ruling). Nothing found.
note: Bike supplier whose logo appears on the kit. Rating note: Youngone Corporation (South Korea) controls Scott Sports; South Korea has no sourced record of serious abuses under the method, so a Korean state stake wouldn't count, and no human-rights finding against Scott or Youngone was located.
